question.text: What is Jüri Reinvere known for?
quotes: Jüri Reinvere (born 1971) is an Estonian composer, poet and essayist whose music and writing explore history, politics, nature and human perception.
Jüri Reinvere (born 1971) is an Estonian composer, poet and essayist who has lived in Germany since 2005 and is a Finnish citizen.
